items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I studied with a fella named Roger Eckers... [INTERVIEWEE] And he taught you saxophone.

ctx.x: Well I studied with a fella named Roger Eckers who was a local teacher, and then I went to school at Fredonia.
